mechanics.claim: Only the next 2 basic attacks after casting an ability are empowered, and only if they land within 3 seconds on-hit.
mechanics.quote: his next 2 {{tip|basic attacks}} within a short time gain {{sti|attack speed|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and restore {{sti|{{as|energy}}}}

mechanics.claim: The second empowered attack restores half the energy of the first.
mechanics.quote: the second attack restores{{ft|{{as|{{pp|10 to 20 for 3|1 to 13}} energy}}.|half of the previous amount.}}
